source: Human and Guardian Technology Broker recipes from the bundled material catalog

Guardian.blueprint: Activate the Guardian structure, charge the pylons and scan the data terminal for the required blueprint segment.
Guardian.components: Collect destructible-panel components and Guardian Sentinel drops at Guardian structures; scan active obelisks for pattern data.
Guardian.broker: Take the complete one-time recipe to a Guardian Technology Broker and unlock the module.

Human.components: Collect the complete listed recipe from normal material sources, mission rewards or the matching Material Trader.
Human.broker: Take the complete recipe to a Human Technology Broker and unlock the item.

origins.component: Guardian structure · destructible panels and Sentinel drops
origins.conventional: Human material sources or the matching Material Trader
